cards.note: No agent/session-start listener and no ctx.agents use; the plugin registers no agent lifecycle hook.
No @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot dependency; the plugin never boots or audits a config tree.
Reads no Session history (eventAt/snapshotEvents/ownEvents absent); usage comes from its own usage.json fold.
Owns no SessionEventMap event and registers no message projection; it rewrites no message content.
No ctx.hmr use, no config-reload watcher and no programmatic entry mutation.
Mounts no session-log-deepseek row and ships no test profile composition that would.
No code-runtime/ptc-runtime dependency, import, row or provider; execution is out of this plugin's scope.
Implements no SandboxProvider and calls no ctx.sandbox.confine.
No ctx.shell implementor or consumer; no background command is started.
No SubprocessRuntime implementor; supplier modules run in-process and the plugin never spawns a child.
Mounts/registers no workflowEngine provider and names no workflow row.
No MCP client row/config and no @modelcontextprotocol/sdk import.
No ctx.mcpResources consumer and no custom MCP bridge.
No ctx.ssh use; the only 'ssh' token is a sidebar DOM selector in the slot-less fallback.

Adapter already reads images via readImageRequest(ref,{width,height,maxBytes}); none of the three removed offload symbols are used, and durable offloaded marks are now projected (no self-shrinking). No request-wide route image budget exists by design, so nothing to report via IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED - documented at adapter.ts:207.
Never configures llm-deepseek / DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL; it registers its own 'router' provider speaking OpenAI to its own /v1.
No @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek import and no imagePixelBudget catalog; MAX_REQUEST_PIXELS/MAX_REQUEST_BYTES are plugin-local.
Does not read contextBreakdown/contextPressure or any token-meter projection state; it only emits DSH TokenUsage.
No AssistantProvenance/AssistantProviderMetadata import or read on either half.
Client renders no conversation/chat nodes and imports no provenance/producer view types.
Registers no InputTriggerSource and builds no CommandClaim.
Renders no composer permission control and reads no permissions projection.
No sidebarRightTabs registration, guide entries or close handlers.
Renders no ConnectionIndicator; primitives use is limited to Switch and Button.
No DiffBlock/diffTotals use (not exported through the plugin's primitives face).
No ?fixture page mode and no CI lane that opens the served client with it.
Patch inserts only dsh-router* rows; workflow-worker-thread is never named or depended on.

ImageBlock.offloaded marks are projected with projectOffloadedImages/offloadedImageText (adapter.ts:213) and defensively for nested legacy tool-result content (adapter.ts:361); offloaded bytes are never read or sent. Two regression tests added.
No ralph tool dependency or prompt/automation that assumes it.
Never mounted an mcp-resources row, so there is no hand-added row to drop.
Patch names no code-runtime row; the client reads the slot registry instead of hardcoding sidebar/settings composition.
Only @deepseek-ai/schemastery plus host-provided peers; no retired package coordinate in manifest or lockfile.
No headless invocation or CLI output parsing in-tree.
No @deepseek-ai/dsh-package-manifest import; the dsh.bundle shape is declared locally and checked by its own script.
No mirrored release set and no experimental first-party package dependency.
No node-addon-require-builtin resolution in the manifest or either lockfile.
README documents the built-in patch as web-profile only; Desktop install is not a target, so the shared-package peer rules are not triggered.
Negative evidence for every plugin upgrading from rc.2; no session-format, engine-floor or CLI-grammar action to take.
Never reads sessions.list/SessionListState.current; the current session id arrives through the slot's session scope.
Does not use useSessionPendingInteraction; the dock's only standard prop is sessionId.
Already shipped as a bundle with dsh.bundle.patch, so it is managed through the Plugin Manager / dsh plugin path; no link-only install to migrate.
Release-process awareness for host upgrades (npm publish lag); no plugin source surface.
Imports no primitives icons at all; the *16 -> *Medium/*Regular rename cannot hit Switch/Button.
No workspaceFiles Remote read on either half; panel data comes from its own /router/api routes.

Settings registration is on the new scheme: 0.1.7+ takes the mirror row from the exported volatile Config keyed by the bundle row id, and settings.installSection is only probed on 0.1.5 hosts (index.ts:744-764); panel values stay in the plugin's own state.json by documented design. Verified on 0.2.0-rc.1 (Router card present).
Ships no agent presets and declares no preset bundle field.
Parses no raw session logs; every durable file it owns (state.json, usage.json, ext.json, credentials.sqlite) is plugin-private.
Does not configure the official DeepSeek provider; its adapter speaks OpenAI chat-completions to its own /v1 gateway.
Single small cordis.patch.yml is still valid (bundlePatchFiles accepts a string or an ordered list); the Config is empty so there are no no-reload fields to declare.
Loader-level tolerance only; no plugin action. Boot roster is the check that the row still mounted.
Optional Plugin Manager display metadata; the shipped subpath rows already carry locale meta, and no root icon/localized title is required for the documented entry points.
Stores no attachment payloads in custom session events; credentials and usage live in plugin-owned stores.
Uses neither settings.launcher nor settings.models.sign-in.
Carries no spill-policy configuration row or maxInlineBytes key.
Cordis is a host-provided peer, not a vendored dependency of this plugin; no lockfile action requested by the card.
Plugin Manager install-UX change only; the documented install command is unchanged and no plugin code touches registry selection.
Client bundles are cached at host boot, so a client-bundle edit needs a host restart; no plugin source action.
Every DSH peer is now '^0.1.5-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1' (package.json:103-107), so 0.1.7-rc.1 is admitted and the host's startup peer check no longer disables the rows.
Registers no tool.call.toolview entry and reads no RunningToolCall/ToolCallBlock records.
Implements no ConversationNodeDefinition / UiConversation.events.
Reads/writes no chat transcriptView setting and branches on no TranscriptViewMode.
Install-path behavior only; the documented dsh plugin CLI inherits the terminal, and the plugin has no install automation in-tree.
Peers use '... || ^0.2.0-rc.1' (package.json:103-107): 0.2.0-rc.1 is admitted and the future 0.2.0 final stays admitted; plain ^0.2.0 would be refused.
Does not read the Chat settings schema or assume a transcriptView default.
Patch inserts only dsh-router* ids and references no schedule/time-context/ui-schedule row.
Inserts rows into the same composition, but its ids (dsh-router*) do not collide with otel/product-analytics; nothing to rename or gate.
Does not fork sessions; no ISessions.fork call site.
Carries no local native-command or Explorer reveal patch.
